responsibility: Implements the machine-description patterns for PowerPC synchronization and atomic memory operations. It defines fences such as sync, lwsync, and isync, load-acquire/store-release sequencing, larx/stcx and lqarx/stqcx based atomic loads, stores, exchanges, compare-and-swap, and fetch-op expanders, delegating complex lowering to rs6000 atomic helpers where needed and providing the backend’s RTL interface for GCC’s atomic builtins and memory model support.
